WITH per_status AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate
  FROM per_status
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT p.avg_rate, p.scan_count, a.all_status_avg_rate
  FROM per_status AS p
  CROSS JOIN status_average AS a
  WHERE a.all_status_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_rate > a.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_of_statuses,
  AVG(1.0 * scan_count) AS avg_scan_count,
  AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: The average across statuses is an unweighted average of each status's average rate; statuses with no non-NULL rate still count in the scan count but have NULL rates and cannot qualify as above average.
